name: a read that fails still answers the envelope
description: The other half of the mixed contract, and the pair to read-blob.json: success is bytes, failure is JSON. Both halves have to hold or the PHP client cannot branch on the status code — it would have to guess whether a body is a file or an error document. Every read failure is reported as 404, including a malformed handle and an unreachable backend, because the caller holds one engine/handle pair per file and has nothing else to try; the detail is in the service log.
